info.name: Ascend Advanced Therapies Content API (WordPress REST) Careers Posts API

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit results to items assigned to the given category IDs.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit results to items assigned to the given tag IDs.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to items with one of the given slugs.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of published posts. The site's `post` type is labelled "News & Insights" and carries the news, articles, blogs, and webinar categories. Total count and page count are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages headers.
